question: Can a person lacking formal learning still qualify through devotion to the guru and firm vows?
premises: A person may be unlearned in scriptures.
The same person may be devoted to the guru.
The same person may be firm in vows.
inference: Devotion to the guru and steadfast vows can qualify one despite lack of formal learning.
plain_english: Even if unlearned and not knowing the scriptures, one who is devoted to the guru and firm in vows.
